text:
elaine-support: Heads-up — AcmeBio just opened a support ticket: their ACH payout (Transfer ID 20250314-ACME-9876543) was returned by the bank. Customer says bank returned for wrong routing number. Screenshot attached.
sam-customer: Bank msg: "Returned — routing number not found (ACH R03)". Customer pasted routing: 021000021, account ending 4321. They tried three times (03/14). Wants funds resent ASAP.
elaine-support: Escalating to payments. @tony-payments can you run a trace and confirm whether we submitted the correct routing? Also check whether our onboarding validation accepted that routing.
tony-payments: Got it. Pulling trace now. Our payout record shows routing 021000021 and account *******4321 — that matches what customer sent. Sending trace to bank for return details.
billing-bot: Payment trace created: trace_id=tr_20250314_9876543. Status=returned. Reason_code=R03. Bank_response="routing number invalid".
jade-eng: Quick question — did we ever send wires for that customer (wire vs ACH)? If they originally supplied IBAN/SWIFT for wire, mismatch could happen. For ACH, SWIFT doesn't apply but if they used cross-border method, bank might have mapped incorrectly.
ton y-payments: (typo) sorry. We checked: payout method=ACH US. No wire involved. Bank returned for routing. Reached out to customer to confirm the routing with their bank. Also asked for a bank-issued confirmation letter or screenshot of their account details.
sam-customer: I confirmed with our bank: our teller says the correct routing is 021000021 for domestic and SWIFT BOFAUS3N for international wires. They said the return was because the receiving bank flagged mismatched account metadata (name mismatch). They provided a PDF from the bank.
elaine-support: Thanks. Two possible failure causes: (1) wrong routing typed at bank, (2) beneficiary name mismatch flagged by receiving bank. Tony — can you attach the NACHA return file and the raw ACH batch record so we can see the name we sent and the receiver name field?
tony-payments: Attached ACH file excerpt and NACHA return. sent_name=ACMEBIO INC, receiver_name=ACME BIO LLC, ACH entry trace shows receiver_name=ACME BIO LLC. Bank returned with note: "Mismatched beneficiary name/routing". I'm opening a dispute with receiving bank; also prepping a reissue.
jade-eng: If it's a name normalization issue (periods/commas/corp vs inc), we should normalize names at payout creation and record original customer-supplied legal entity. Might reduce returns. Filing a small follow-up RFC to payments and ingest.
tony-payments: Next steps: 1) Ask customer to confirm legal entity name on their bank account (they provided doc, looks like "ACME BIO LLC"). 2) Reissue payout with corrected receiver_name and same routing. 3) If bank demands, provide proof of payee identity. I've queued a reissue for smaller test amount $100 to ensure it clears. Trace id new: tr_20250314_9876543_retry1.
sam-customer: Please do that. We need this cleared today.
billing-bot: Reissue queued: tr_20250314_9876543_retry1, amount=100, status=pending.
tony-payments: Bank confirmed receipt for the $100 test — cleared. Proceeding to reissue full amount. Customer will receive within 1-2 business days. Also we logged the original return under internal case CASE-2025-114.
elaine-support: Great. Can we update docs to recommend customers to supply exact legal entity name and optional bank letter when adding ACH? Jade — add to RFC.
jade-eng: Added RFC: PAY-1107 "Normalize & verify beneficiary names on ACH onboarding". I'll own a short spike to see if we can auto-suggest normalized names during onboarding.
tony-payments: Closing the ticket once full amount settled. FYI — this is a useful reminder: when customers ask to use wire (SWIFT/IBAN) vs ACH, confirm currency and bank routing type; sending SWIFT fields on an ACH can cause mapping errors.
elaine-support: Closing note for support: tell customers to double-check routing + legal entity name and to attach a bank letter for high-value payouts. Marking as resolved pending settlement confirmation. :white_check_mark:
sam-customer: Thank you — received confirmation that funds posted later today. Appreciate the quick help! :thumbsup:
